facts.fact: Development Pathways says Uganda's Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development commissioned the digital National Single Registry on 4 February 2021, with WFP supporting its implementation and maintenance since 2020.
Development Pathways says the National Single Registry consolidates information on beneficiaries across multiple social protection schemes and integrates the WFP Karamoja Social Registry.

systems.platform: web-based integrated beneficiary and social registry
systems.owner: Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development
